cards.name: Expand
cards.summary: Turns the selected live blend into ordinary artwork: the key objects and every intermediate step become separate paths inside a group, and the blend stops updating when you edit the key objects.
use_for: finalising a blend before sending artwork to print, a cutter or another app
recolouring or deleting individual steps of a blend
using blend steps as separate shapes (stripes, stacked 3D-type layers, line patterns)
avoid: a blend you may still tweak: expanding is one-way; keep a hidden copy or use Release instead to get the key objects back
very high step counts: you get hundreds of paths, keep steps low or use Specified Distance first
cards.how: Select the blend object, then run the command. No dialog. Object > Expand on a selected blend does the same job.
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("Path Blend Expand"). The id was paired from the keyboard-shortcut list, not confirmed by running it. The harvest's live test was inconclusive: it neither changed the test document nor opened a dialog, so the id is still unconfirmed.

review.changes: script_api: removed the invented reason for the inconclusive test (batch only says it neither changed the document nor opened a dialog)

cards.name: Make
cards.summary: Creates a live blend between two or more selected objects: Illustrator fills the space between them with intermediate shapes that morph shape and colour from one to the next, following a straight spine. Editing a key object later updates the steps.
use_for: smooth colour or shape transitions (stacked type, retro stripes, tube-like 3D lettering)
evenly spaced repeats between two copies of an object (dotted rows, rungs, rays)
line-art waves and abstract flowing backgrounds from two curved strokes
avoid: a plain colour transition inside one shape: a gradient or gradient mesh is lighter
objects with very different structure or complex appearances: steps can twist; simplify the key objects or make the blend with the Blend tool, clicking matching anchor points on each object
cards.how: Select the key objects and run Make. How the steps are spaced comes from Object > Blend > Blend Options: Spacing Smooth Color (Illustrator picks the steps), Specified Steps or Specified Distance, and Orientation Align to Page or Align to Path. The Blend tool makes the same blend by clicking the objects in turn.
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("Path Blend Make") (confirmed by the harvest: two selected paths became one blend object). The blend options have no object-model setter; set them in Blend Options or in a saved default.

review.changes: avoid: twisting remedy was 'use Specified Steps' (spacing does not fix twist); now Blend tool on matching anchor points

cards.name: Release
cards.summary: Removes the selected blend: the intermediate steps are deleted and the original key objects come back as ordinary objects. The blend's spine is normally left behind as a separate path with no fill or stroke, so check for it and delete it if you do not need it.
use_for: undoing a blend while keeping its key objects
rebuilding a blend with different key objects or settings
avoid: keeping the step shapes: Release deletes them, use Expand instead
cards.how: Select the blend object and run the command. No dialog.
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("Path Blend Release"). The id was paired from the keyboard-shortcut list, not confirmed by running it.

review.changes: none

cards.name: Replace Spine
cards.summary: Makes the steps of a blend follow a path you drew: with a blend and a separate path selected, the path becomes the blend's new spine and the key objects and steps are redistributed along it.
use_for: blends that run along a curve, circle or wave (beaded strings, swirls, curved type stacks)
spacing repeated objects along a custom route
avoid: only the blend selected: it needs both the blend and the path
repeating an object along a path without morphing: a pattern or scatter brush is simpler
cards.how: Draw the path, select it together with the blend object and run Replace Spine. Set Orientation Align to Path in Blend Options if the steps should rotate with the curve. No dialog.

avoid: swapping the start and end positions of the key objects: use Reverse Spine

cards.name: Make
cards.summary: Combines the selected paths into one compound path: they share one fill and stroke, and where they overlap the shape gets holes (controlled by the fill rule and path direction). The result takes the paint of the backmost object.
use_for: letterforms and logos with counters (O, A, rings, donuts)
cut-out shapes and stencils for vinyl or laser cutting
a single clipping path made of several shapes
avoid: merging shapes into one outline with no holes: use Pathfinder Unite
objects that need different colours: a compound path has only one fill
cards.how: Select the paths and run Make. No dialog. If a hole fills in, switch the fill rule in the Attributes panel or reverse a subpath's direction.
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("compoundPath"). The id was paired from the keyboard-shortcut list, not confirmed by running it. Object model: var cp = doc.compoundPathItems.add(); then move each path into cp (unverified).

cards.name: Release

avoid: expecting the original colours back: every released path gets the compound's fill
